transfer_taxes.name: Michigan state real estate transfer tax
transfer_taxes.source_title: State Real Estate Transfer Tax Act (MCL Act 330 of 1993)
transfer_taxes.notes: $3.75 per $500. Seller/grantor liable. Exemption 6(u): principal residence (7cc) sales at arm's length where SEV at sale is <= SEV when seller acquired it (rare in rising markets; refundable).

transfer_taxes.source_title: Wayne County Register of Deeds: Document Recording
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.55 per $500 (page: county + state = $8.60 per $1,000). Seller customarily/legally pays (county act liability not fetched).
